notes.title: Lightale Update - EA v1.1.3
notes.content:
[h3][u][b]Lightale EA v1.1.3 Changelog[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new BGM (special thanks to music composer - Yevhenii Doiar).
[*] Added new set of skills (special thanks to backer - ryumi).
[*] Added new illustrations.
[*] Added Chinese Language for skill details and globe details.
[*] Added extra skills for battle once player completed certain chapters.
[*] Improved skill details box prompt.
[*] Improved battle VFX.
[*] Refined story of Chapter 1.3 and Chapter 2.1.
[/list]
